mapping_note: Two separate driver sets, and they are NEVER summed. scenarios is CASH ONLY and is what produces TCO, percent recovered and payback. capacity_scenarios is the counter-minutes line and is printed under its own CAPACITY heading with an explicit note that it is not money. For the cash set pursuits_per_year is staffed_days_per_season, and the avoided_cost_line reads events_per_year as staffed days, cost_per_event as contribution dollars per retained seat, and reduction as retained SEATS PER STAFFED DAY.
